chapters.title: Gute Reise!
communication: understand and hold conversations about planning a trip
grammar: infinitive with zu (after verbs, adjective+sein/finden, noun+haben/machen)

chapters.title: Das ist ja praktisch!
communication: talk about buying habits and services
compare ads, give own opinion on advertising

chapters.title: Veraenderungen
communication: understand reports about changes in life
make a radio programme / understand it
grammar: Praeteritum (regular and irregular, plus special verbs denken/wissen/bringen/nennen)
Perfekt vs Praeteritum: when to use which (spoken vs written; sein, haben, modals almost always Praeteritum)
time expressions: prepositions with Dativ and Genitiv (e.g. waehrend, seit, vor, nach)
strategy: writing own texts from a model
culture: boxing as more than a sport

chapters.title: Arbeitswelt
communication: ask for and give info on the phone
grammar: Konjunktiv II forms: sein, haben, modals, wuerde + infinitive
uses: polite request, wish, advice, unreal condition
verbs with prepositions and subordinate clauses (e.g. sich freuen auf / darauf, dass)
culture: application and job interview in Germany

chapters.title: Umweltfreundlich?
grammar: comparative and superlative before nouns (declined; mehr/weniger no ending)

chapters.title: Blick nach vorn
communication: talk and write about visions of the future
grammar: Futur I (werden + infinitive; other ways to express future: present + time word, wollen/moechten, vorhaben/anfangen)
relative clauses in Dativ and with prepositions
strategy: learning German with music and songs

chapters.title: Zwischenmenschliches
communication: talk about conflicts, hold conflict talks
grammar: temporal subordinate clauses: bevor, bis, nachdem, seit/seitdem, waehrend (plus als/wenn review)
strategy: stressing texts well when reading aloud

chapters.title: Rund um Koerper und Geist
communication: find info in an info text
pass on key info from a newspaper article
grammar: reflexive pronouns in Akkusativ and Dativ (with extra accusative object -> Dativ)
two-part connectors (zweiteilige Konnektoren, e.g. entweder ... oder, sowohl ... als auch, weder ... noch)
culture: places of the senses in D-A-CH

chapters.title: Kunststuecke
communication: pass on information from newspaper texts
understand an interview and an improv story
talk about singing and folk songs
grammar: position of nicht in the sentence (five positions; sondern)
adjectives without article (endings as definite article)

chapters.title: Miteinander
communication: understand an article about a project
talk about institutions in the city
grammar: Passiv Praesens (werden + Partizip II; von + Dativ)
Passiv Praeteritum and Perfekt (wurde ...; ist ... worden)
Passiv with modal verb (muss ... abgeholt werden)
pronunciation: contrast accents in questions with oder

chapters.title: Stadt, Land, Fluss
communication: talk about life in the city
grammar: relative clauses with was and wo

chapters.title: Geld regiert die Welt?
strategy: getting a word in during discussions
